trigger.rule: A model with direct-command success in exactly one direction receives a ten-seed direct-command directional-bias confirmation and no wording sweep.

prompts.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
prompts.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

pairing_rule: Within every seed, LEFT and RIGHT share the neutral reset, environment seed, sampling-seed root, checkpoint, static controller, ten-action open-loop horizon, and execution configuration. Only the direction word and requested-relation task checker change.

analysis_plan.primary: Report exact LEFT and RIGHT successes out of ten with Wilson 95% intervals.
analysis_plan.paired_effect: For every seed, report first-ten-action RMS, both final target-relative endpoints, RIGHT-minus-LEFT endpoint shift, and whether the ordering aligns with the prompt change.
analysis_plan.progression: Report interaction, verified pickup, ever entered requested region, and relation-and-release success separately by direction.
analysis_plan.exclusions: Repair and rerun infrastructure-invalid cells at the same seed. Retain every valid behavioral failure. Thermal intervention invalidates latency, not behavior.

claim_boundary: This adaptive confirmation was frozen after the six pilot outcomes were known and before seeds 8303-8309 were run. It tests a checkpoint-specific DROID directional asymmetry and does not estimate a VLA-class effect.
